framing: Only a few tips match your description.

ai.signal: River for the first 2 km, then forest paths that turn muddy after rain, quiet on weekdays with almost nobody else around

tips.author: Lena
tips.text: The first part follows the river and it’s calm. After the bridge it turns into forest paths…

tips.author: Marek
tips.text: About 2 km along the water, then the forest. A bit muddy after rain, but quiet…

tips.author: Sofia
tips.text: Short stretch by the river at the start, the rest is forest. We met almost no one on a Wednesday…

tips.author: Anna-Katharina-Friederike
tips.text: We followed the water for about two kilometres, then the path went into the forest. Muddy in spots after rain, but nice…

ai.signal: River at the start, then streets with traffic
